hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
err=$(git ls-files -z -mo --exclude-standard -- '*.jl' 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 -r julia -e 'using JuliaFormatter; foreach(format, ARGS)' -- 2>&1 >/dev/null) || true
[ -z "$err" ] || { printf 'JuliaFormatter: %s\n' "$err" >&2; exit 1; }
exit 0
